subject: Offline deployment acceptance runbook and site handoff
messages:
From: Chiron Labs Security <security@chironlabs.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Requirements for islanded site bundle acceptance

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the quick walkthrough earlier. As we prep our isolated site (no egress) for the Redwood private image, the security team needs a concise acceptance runbook we can follow during on-site ingest. Specifically we need:

- Signed bundle manifest showing key fingerprint and timestamp
- Step-by-step verification commands (hash checks, sig verification) that operators can run in an air-gapped environment
- Chain-of-custody checklist for physical media (who signs, who transports)
- Rollback procedure and emergency hotfix path for critical CVEs

If you can send a short runbook + the key fingerprint and indicate which signatures will be present (company primary signer vs build signer), we can align the SOC acceptance criteria and schedule a verification window.

We are targetting the week of 6/22 for physical delivery — please confirm what you need from our side (PO, on-site recipients, carrier info).

Thanks,
Chiron Labs Security Team
[Chiron internal ticket: CHR-8812]
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Chiron Labs Security <security@chironlabs.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Requirements for islanded site bundle acceptance

Hi — appreciate the clear list. Attached is a first-draft runbook we use for sterile-site acceptance: acceptance_checklist_v1.pdf. Highlights:

1) Signed manifest: we include a timestamped manifest plus our build-signer and release-signer fingerprints. We will provide signed_key_manifest.txt (detached sig) with SHA256 checksums.

2) Verification steps: three simple commands are included (sha256sum, gpg --verify with provided public keys, and container image digest verification for the appliance bundle) — all work offline.

3) Chain-of-custody: short template for courier handoff and two-person sign-off.

4) Rollback: documented fallback to previous bundle and emergency seed image; we include instructions for applying a hotfix tarball in the field if needed.

Next steps I propose:
- We confirm the exact public key fingerprints you will trust (we currently plan to publish: 0xA1B2C3D4DEADBEEF and 0xBEEF112233445566).
- Dev to confirm operator commands are minimal and do not require extra packages.
- Agree on on-site recipient names and PO/tracking info.

Call options: Tue (6/16) 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed (6/17) 14:00–15:00 PT — which works for your team?

Attachments: [Attachment: acceptance_checklist_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 152KB)]

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Customer Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-11T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Requirements for islanded site bundle acceptance

Sofia — quick notes from the runtime team after reviewing the draft:

- Fingerprints: Confirming build signer 0xA1B2C3D4DEADBEEF (build pipeline) and release signer 0xBEEF112233445566 (release manager). We will produce signed_key_manifest.txt with detached signatures.
- Verification commands: keep to POSIX utilities — sha256sum, gpg, and skopeo inspect (or docker/ctr) for image digests. I added a small single-file helper script (handoff_instructions.md references helper.sh) to normalize output for operators.
- Key rotation note: if Chiron requires on-site key rotation, we need a lead time of 7 business days to sign new bundles and update manifests.

Also tagging possible ops: please confirm if the site prefers GPG armored public keys vs raw binary for easier offline transfer.

Using the call Sofia proposed — I can join Tue 6/16 10:00 PT.

-- Dev
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
[Attachment: signed_key_manifest.txt (text/plain, 4KB)]
From: Jill Townsend <jill.townsend@fintechco.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Chiron Labs Security <security@chironlabs.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-12T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Requirements for islanded site bundle acceptance

Thanks everyone — Chiron Security confirms we reviewed the checklist and the manifest fingerprints. We prefer GPG armored public keys for the courier USB and will provide the on-site recipient list this Friday 6/18.

Action items captured:
- Redwood: finalize signed_key_manifest.txt and include armored public key files in the drive link.
- Chiron: provide PO and on-site recipients by 6/18; schedule courier pickup for week of 6/22.
- Both: plan a 30-minute verification window during ingest on the day of delivery; Dev and Sofia to join remotely.

If you can drop the final handoff_instructions.md to the Drive folder (see link), we’ll confirm acceptance and sign the chain-of-custody sheet on delivery.

Best,
Jill Townsend
Security Program Manager (contracted to Chiron)
